fieldNotes.locating: Roster coords (42.666811, -88.267276, ROOFTOP, moved 103m) landed accurately on the plant. Web research confirmed the Nestlé USA baking plant at 637 S Pine St, Burlington WI - the Toll House plant (chocolate-chip morsels + refrigerated cookie dough; began 1966; ~520,000 sq ft; recent $70M+ cookie-dough conversion). Locked center 42.66550, -88.26800.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate identified. The plant sits in an industrial park; the SW truck yard reads as open paved area continuous with the industrial-park streets - Google Street View cars drove freely into the truck yard, capturing parked tractors and box trucks with no barrier arm or pinch-point. The corporate office frontage on S Pine St is also open (monument sign, lawn, no gate). Classified false; flagged uncertain (a gate could be open/unstaffed during capture, and an active Nestlé plant typically has some entry control).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at any entrance in satellite or Street View. False.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Substantial dock banks on the S and SW building faces with many trailers backed in; ~30-50 doors estimated, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yards on the W/NW and SW holding ~50-70 parked trailers in rows; banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows separate from the active dock aprons - dropYard true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on the S and the NW building faces suggest physically separate ship/receive - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur curves off the adjacent rail line and runs into the plant property on the NW - railServed true.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Burlington is a small Wisconsin city (~10,000); the plant is in an edge-of-town industrial park beside the Fox River with adjacent residential subdivisions. Per rubric tie-break (small-town industrial), classified Rural.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved truck yard gives ample internal stacking room - long approach.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~455m N-S x ~545m E-W) ~ 30 acres.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main multi-section plant building plus a large secondary building/warehouse on the W.

citations.claim: Burlington plant remained in Nestlé's hands and was NOT part of the 2018 US confectionery sale to Ferrero; continues Toll House morsel production
Nestlé overhauling the Burlington WI factory for Toll House refrigerated cookie dough production (ongoing operation + reinvestment)

verification.rationale: Toll House baking plant EXPLICITLY excluded from the 2018 Ferrero confectionery sale; reinvested for cookie dough, still Nestlé-operated.
